text.title: 运河旁的地图
text.situation:
下一次轮班前，林参加了旧厂房中心的公众参观。中心位于运河旁，离广场步行不远。在桥边的地图上，她沿着车站过来的路线看。一条路穿过山下的隧道，另一条直通停车场。乔拿着建筑参观计划，在自行车架旁等候。

乔：以前大家来这里是到工厂上班，现在来上课和参加活动。
林：地图上远不止这栋楼。
乔：是的，这里是城市里的地点，所以计划也考虑小路、道路和排水。基础设施影响大家怎样到达。
林：我明白桥为什么和前门一样重要了。

今日参观
在运河桥旁集合。经过停车场，到标出的入口。展览在已完成的西翼，主楼仍因施工关闭。

paragraphs.en: Before her next shift, Lin joined a public visit to the old mill centre. The centre was situated beside a canal, a short walk from the square. On a map by the bridge, she traced the route from the station. One road passed through a tunnel beneath the hill; another led directly to the car park. Jo was waiting beside a bicycle rack, holding the plan for the building visit.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: People used to come here for factory work. Now they come for classes and events.
Lin: The map shows much more than the building.
Jo: Yes. It is an urban site, so the plan also considers paths, roads and drainage. That infrastructure affects how people reach us.
Lin: I can see why the bridge matters as much as the front door.

paragraphs.en:
Today’s visit
Meet beside the canal bridge. Walk past the car park to the marked entrance. The exhibition is in the completed west wing. The main building remains closed for construction work.
